Try itKeep two clocks apart: plan and control

  • Goal: know which clock a time belongs to.
  • Two clocks run in this lecture, and later frames name the clock with its number.

ClockEveryWhat happens
Planning cycle0.5 sthe local planner makes a new path or trajectory
Control step0.05 s (20 a second)steer, throttle and brake go out; CARLA ticks
t = 0.00 stry it
Other times are not clocks: how late the car answers (the steering and engine delays and lags), and how far ahead a plan looks (a horizon, such as the trajectory planner's 7 s).
